sources.title: Kronos-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Kronos-base is a 102.3M-parameter decoder-only foundation model for financial time series forecasting, developed by NeoQuasar. It specializes in predicting candlestick (K-line) data—the OHLCV (open, high, low, close, volume) format used in financial markets—and was trained on over 12 billion K-line records from 45 global exchanges. sources.title: Kronos: The AI Model for Financial Markets
sources.snippet: Enter Kronos —the world's first open-source foundation model specifically engineered for the chaotic, high-dimensional world of financial markets. This breakthrough isn't just another incremental improvement; it's a paradigm shift that democratizes institutional-grade AI forecasting for developers, quants, and researchers worldwide.
